_provenance: Unedited output from the deployed /api/analyse endpoint (claude-sonnet-4-5), captured 2026-07-26. Nothing here is estimated or hand-authored. Swatch rows were sampled twice each and returned byte-identical values both times.
_readMe: Two groups, deliberately. The photographs carry weave and relief, so the model separates them sharply. The swatches are solid-colour placeholder PNGs with no texture to read, and three of the four collapse onto the same answer. Publishing both is the honest version: it shows what the tool discriminates on, and what it cannot.
_swatchFinding: Silk and linen are byte-identical and denim is within 0.04 of both. With no weave in the image the model has only hue to go on, and two pale neutrals read as the same material. Leather separates because its hue is far enough away. Replacing these placeholders with real fabric photographs is the fix.
